mechanic:break_mine.art_style: Split. Bright simulator promo renders (green grass, cyan sky, bacon-hair) lead at about 6/12, and cinematic dark or realistic-lit renders follow at about 5/12; one is a gameplay screenshot.
avoid: Plain gameplay screenshots of machines in a grey cave
Several small targets competing; one giant target wins
mechanic:break_mine.direction: Icon: a giant egg with glowing lava or crystal cracks taking up half the frame, a Roblox avatar mid-swing with an oversized pickaxe, and chips and sparks bursting at the impact point under dramatic rim lighting. Thumbnail: the same egg splitting open to reveal a rare glowing creature, with a red curved arrow and a '0.001%' callout, shot from a low angle so the egg towers over the miner.
do: Make the breakable target (egg or ore) fill about 50% of the icon, with glowing cracks (lava orange or crystal blue) so it reads as 'about to burst'
Show the avatar mid-swing with an oversized pickaxe or hammer at the moment of impact, with chips flying
Give the thumbnail one rarity hook: a red curved arrow at the rare drop plus a percentage like '0.001%' in outlined text
To read as new, try a cinematic version: low camera, dramatic sunset or cave rim-light, a huge target dwarfing a tiny miner
Keep text to one short callout; let the object carry the icon

icon_patterns.pattern: The breakable target is the hero object, big and glowing: lava-cracked egg in a nest, green dragon egg, blue crystal egg, golden vault, cracked giant egg, purple ore
Specifically an egg as the thing being broken or dug out
Roblox avatar mid-swing with a tool (pickaxe, hammer, drill, shovel) right next to the target
Bacon-hair or classic Roblox avatar as the character
Dark, cinematic lighting (black studio, cave, red-lit T-rex, sunset city) instead of the bright simulator palette
Underground framing: dirt cross-section or cave tunnel around the target

mechanic:break_mine.newcomer_shift: 3 of the 4 NEW games (Smash the City, Prehistoric Farm, Tower Incremental) drop the bright simulator formula for moody cinematic shots: a meteor over a sunset skyline, a pink-lit T-rex in a dark jungle, a dark wooden tower interior. They have almost no text, and 2 use an hourglass 'idle/time' symbol. Only Dig For Eggs keeps the classic shocked-bacon + red arrow + crystal egg look, moved into a voxel first-person view.
mechanic:break_mine.summary: Break/mine leaders show a Roblox avatar swinging a tool at a huge glowing egg, ore or vault on bright grass, while most of the NEW entrants switch to moody, text-free cinematic renders with dramatic scale.
mechanic:break_mine.text_usage: Sparse. Rarity odds or percentages appear on 3/12 thumbnails, a rainbow $/s figure on 1, and small labels ('Dragon Egg', 'UPDATE', '+1 NOW'). Red '!!' or '?!' and red arrows act as text substitutes on 2 icons.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Glowing prize at the focal point: lava eggs, winged lucky-block egg, gold vault, rainbow crystal ore, blue diamond egg
Character actively breaking the target (pickaxe swing, drill into dirt, two chubby miners chipping a giant egg, first-person hands with pickaxe)
Rarity callout: odds text ('1 in 800,000,000', 'DIVINE 0.001%', '0.000001%') often with a red curved arrow at the prize
Text-free cinematic renders with realistic skies or lighting (giant egg in dark hall, nuke cloud over night city, sea-monster fishing, dark tower interior)

mechanic:collect_index.art_style: Bright simulator promo renders with blocky creatures (about 8/12). The rest are an IP mascot cartoon (Dandy's World), a realistic junkyard car render, and ASMR-style close-ups.
avoid: Static showcase shots with no story (the item just sitting there)
Muddy or realistic palettes unless the collectible itself is realistic (cars)
mechanic:collect_index.direction: Icon: a bacon-hair avatar sprinting toward the camera with a glowing rainbow egg in their arms, a giant roaring creature behind, and a floating 'MYTHIC $64.99M/s' tag above the egg. Thumbnail: the same chase widened onto bright grass, with a red 'YOU' arrow on the avatar and the creature lunging.
do: Show a bacon-hair avatar in motion, clutching a glowing rainbow or lava collectible against their chest
Put a giant angry creature (dino, gorilla, dragon) behind them, at least twice their size
Float a price tag over the collectible: name + 'MYTHIC' or 'SECRET' in gradient text + green '$64.99M/s'
In the thumbnail, frame it as a chase or heist with a red curved arrow or 'YOU' marker
Keep the backdrop bright green grass under a saturated cyan sky

icon_patterns.pattern: Bacon-hair or classic noob avatar as the main character
Giant creature looming behind or beside the avatar (crystal monsters, red sea dragon, brown dino, lava gorilla, blocky dinosaur)
Collectible egg as the prize (lava egg in nest, butter in a cracked egg, glowing egg held aloft, 'Giraffe Egg' label)
Bright green grass and cyan sky backdrop
Floating price/rarity tag on the collectible ('$997,734,214 SECRET', 'Giraffe Egg MYTHIC $64.99M/s')

mechanic:collect_index.newcomer_shift: All 4 NEW games (Dream Car, Swim/Jump/Motorcycle for…) are a bacon-hair in motion (sleeping, swimming, running, riding) with a glowing collectible. 3/4 show a giant beast (lava gorilla, dinosaurs, T-rex), and 3/4 add a floating '$X/s' value with a MYTHIC or SECRET rarity tag, which the leaders mostly don't use.
mechanic:collect_index.summary: Collect/index leaders put a Roblox avatar beside a giant creature or glowing collectible on bright grass, and the NEW wave standardises on '[verb] for animals/eggs' scenes with $/s and MYTHIC/SECRET price tags.
mechanic:collect_index.text_usage: Mostly text-free. Short callouts appear where used: 'YOU' with an arrow, 'BUTTER', a rainbow '$999B/s', and green/rainbow '$/s' plus MYTHIC/SECRET tags. Only Dandy's World shows a logo.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Avatar carrying the prize while chased by, or sneaking past, a giant creature (sleeping chicken, chicken-suit chase, lava gorilla, dinosaurs, T-rex)
Glowing rainbow or lava collectible as the focal point (lava eggs, rainbow Porsche, rainbow egg, lava egg on a bike)
Red curved arrow or 'YOU' callout pointing at the player or hidden object
Bright green grass and cyan sky

mechanic:dice_cards.art_style: Bright, saturated simulator promo renders with pasted anime illustrations (6/8). Only 2/8 use raw in-game screenshots.
avoid: Raw gameplay screenshots with no focal object
Small cards lost in a busy scene; one hero card or die is enough
mechanic:dice_cards.direction: Icon: a glowing gold or rainbow-foil card (or die) held right up to the camera by a white Roblox glove, with speed lines on a blue background and a rainbow-outlined '1 in 9,342,584'-style number across the top. Thumbnail: the same card mid-reveal next to a wide-eyed Roblox avatar, with a UR or NEW! sticker and a 'OPEN PACKS' callout, all on bright cyan.
do: Put the card, pack or die in the centre at 50-60% of the icon, held toward the camera by a white cartoon Roblox hand or glove
Give the object a gold or rainbow rarity glow with a sparkle burst and speed lines radiating from behind it
Run one rainbow-gradient, thick-black-outlined number across the top: the odds ('1 in 9,342,584') or income ('$978,829/s')
For the thumbnail, put a shocked or excited Roblox avatar on one side and the revealed UR or mystery '?' card on the other, with a small NEW! or 'OPEN PACKS' tag
Use a saturated cyan or electric-blue background so the gold or rainbow card stands out

icon_patterns.pattern: The card, die or bingo sheet is the hero object, held up close by white cartoon Roblox hands or a gloved thumbs-up (e.g. gold '?' card in two gloved hands, die pinched in front of the character)
Anime character art is the subject (white-masked warrior, muscular capped fighter, Luffy on a UR card with 5 stars)
Rainbow-gradient, black-outlined number across the top: odds or income ('1 in 9,342,584', '$9,924,544/s', '$978,829/s')
Rarity glow on the object: gold sparkle burst, rainbow foil frame, lightning or speed lines behind the subject

mechanic:dice_cards.summary: Dice/card leaders sell the pull itself: a glowing card, pack or die held right up to the camera by a cartoon Roblox hand, usually with pasted anime character art and a rainbow number promising a huge payout.
mechanic:dice_cards.text_usage: Text is a number, not a title: a rainbow-gradient odds or $/s figure at the top (3/8 icons), plus small rarity tags (UR, 5 stars, 99). Only one icon carries the game logo (Anime Card Clash) and one an UPDATE ribbon.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Anime character art takes up most of the frame (masked warrior, Gear-5 Luffy UR card, three-panel anime fighter strip, anime girl holding a pack)
Mystery or rarity reveal object: golden '?' card, row of rainbow '?' packs, or a 'UR' card with a NEW! sticker
Big outlined callout text: rainbow odds or cash numbers, 'UR', or an 'E OPEN PACKS' key prompt
Plain gameplay screenshot with no styling (drill machine, free-kick pitch); these are the weakest-looking entries

mechanic:forge_craft.art_style: Bright simulator promo renders (about 7/11). A dark fantasy/edgy anime minority uses logos (3/11), and one is a gameplay screenshot.
avoid: Showing only the workstation without the finished item
mechanic:forge_craft.direction: Icon: a hand or bacon-hair avatar holding up a gleaming finished item, with a red curved arrow from a lump of raw material and a big outlined 'SOLD!' callout. Thumbnail: a left-to-right upgrade from a crude version to a glowing masterpiece, ending at a green '+$100m SELL' button with a cursor clicking it.
do: Show the transformation: raw material on the left, a red curved arrow, and the glowing finished item (sword, ring, artwork) on the right
Have a bacon-hair avatar or a first-person hand hold the finished item up toward the camera, sparkling
Finish with the money payoff: a green 'SELL' button with a cursor and '+$100m' in bold outlined text
Keep one short outlined claim ('SOLD!', 'WORLD 8') at large size
Use a bright cyan or warm workshop backdrop that contrasts with the item's gold

icon_patterns.pattern: Red curved arrow linking input to output or pointing at you (ingot → flaming sword, fountain → Mona Lisa, 'SOLD!' → ring, 'YOU' → dragon costume)
Crafted or valuable item presented as the hero: flaming sword, framed painting held overhead, sunflower bouquet, emerald gold ring
Bacon-hair avatar as the crafter
Bold outlined claim text ('WORLD 8', '1,000,000 WINS', 'SOLD!', 'SECRET $67,6m/s')
Dark fire/demon fantasy with a gothic logo (Sol's red beam, armoured knight vs dragon, CloverFall horned figure)

mechanic:forge_craft.newcomer_shift: NEW games show the payoff, not the act of crafting. Jewelry Empire shows a hand holding a gold emerald ring with 'SOLD!', and its thumbnail has a fedora shopkeeper with a '+$100m' green SELL button and cursor. Become and Rob a Brainrot shows a 'YOU' arrow on a gold dragon costume with a 'SECRET $67,6m/s' tag. CloverFall goes full dark edgy demon with a gothic logo.
mechanic:forge_craft.summary: Forge/craft winners show input turning into a valuable output, usually with a red curved arrow from raw material to a glowing crafted item held up by a Roblox avatar, and the NEW games frame it as selling for money or becoming a monster.
mechanic:forge_craft.text_usage: Short punchy callouts (WORLD 8, 1,000,000 WINS, SOLD!, ARRANGE FLOWERS) and money figures. Logos appear only on the dark fantasy entries.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Before→after upgrade with a divider or arrow (forge '+1' → '+1T' sword, coin fountain → painting, flimsy raft → armoured gunship)
Money or score figure as the payoff ('+$100m' with a green SELL button, '$67,6m/s', '1,000,000 WINS')
Dark cinematic fantasy with a logo bottom-left
Bright cyan-sky simulator scene

mechanic:hit_swing.art_style: Stylised bright Roblox promo renders dominate (about 8/12). Anime-style dramatic renders (boxing, racket) and realistic sports renders (CR7-style footballer, golf range) make up the rest.
avoid: Static scenes where nothing is mid-motion
Pile-ups of +1/$ text; this niche sells physical impact
mechanic:hit_swing.direction: Icon: an extreme close-up of the moment of impact, with the object slamming into a Roblox face or out of a swinging tool, white speed lines and an over-the-top reaction filling the frame. Thumbnail: the full swing in wide shot with a glowing curved trajectory arc flying toward a big target or distance number.
do: Freeze the exact frame of contact: the ball or object squashed against the glove, bat or foot, with white speed lines radiating out
Put a face in extreme close-up with an exaggerated reaction (cheek squish, wide terrified eyes) taking up 40%+ of the icon
In the thumbnail, draw a bright curved trajectory arc from the hit to where it lands (goal, chest, distance marker)
Add one escalation number only if there is progression ('level 6.5b')
For sports concepts, a more realistic athlete and stadium render currently reads as fresh

icon_patterns.pattern: Sports object or striking tool as a central subject (boxing glove, skipping stone, kicked ball, shuttlecock, football, pile of golf balls)
Motion and impact cues: speed lines, motion-blur arcs, leaf explosion, ball trail
Extreme close-up face with a strong expression (cheek squished by a glove, terrified flung victim, glowing-eyed silhouette, intense headband player, smug vs shocked duo)
Bacon-hair or classic avatar as the character

mechanic:hit_swing.newcomer_shift: NEW games lean literal and real. Street Soccer Pro uses a realistic footballer in a red #7 kit with a curved free-kick line. Clean all the Balls uses a lifelike golf range with a first-person hand. Word Duel goes social with two reacting avatars, a big red STOP button and speech bubbles. Steal a Chicken uses a dark night shot of a giant crystal creature. Fewer +1 or $ overlays.
mechanic:hit_swing.summary: Hit/swing games freeze the moment of impact (a ball, glove or racket mid-strike with speed lines and arcs, often on an extreme-expression close-up), and the NEW games shift toward realistic sports and party-duel scenes.
mechanic:hit_swing.text_usage: Light. A few value/level callouts, the occasional logo (Racket Rivals), 'NOW!' with an hourglass, and speech bubbles in the word-duel game. Most icons have no text.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Close-up dramatic faces: shocked, intense, glowing-eyed, or smug vs scared
Drawn trajectory arc showing the launch path (skipping splashes, rainbow kick arc into chests, yellow free-kick curve)
Big value or level number ('level 1 → 100 → 6.5b', 'lava egg SECRET $67,51m/s', 'MAGMA CHICKEN $89,121 Sp/s')
Bright saturated sky/grass simulator scene

mechanic:plus_one_stat.art_style: Bright simulator-style promo renders of classic Roblox avatars (10/12), with saturated greens and cyans. The exceptions are a dark FPS corridor and stylised stone busts.
avoid: A static standing pose with no visible action
Dark or muted palettes; 10/12 are bright
mechanic:plus_one_stat.direction: Icon: a bacon-hair avatar caught mid-action (doing our core verb) on a bright green baseplate under a cyan sky, ringed by six chunky white '+1' popups, with a glowing rarity-labelled reward just behind. Thumbnail: a diagonal before/after split from scrawny '+1' to an enormous powered-up '+1T' version, joined by a red curved arrow.
do: Scatter 5-8 chunky white '+1' numerals with thick black outlines around the avatar, bigger near the action
Pose a bacon-hair avatar mid-verb (punch, throw, swing) with motion blur, filling about 60% of the icon
Use a bright green baseplate and cyan sky; add one glowing reward (rarity-labelled egg or weapon) at the edge
Make the thumbnail a diagonal split: tiny weak version '+1' on the left, red arrow, massive version '+1T' on the right
Add a red 'WORLD 2' or event banner at the bottom when there is an update to announce

icon_patterns.pattern: White, black-outlined '+1' numerals scattered around the character (or '+1M/s', or +1 with flexing-arm emoji)
Bacon-hair Roblox avatar as the hero (yellow classic noob in 2 more)
Character in a dynamic pose doing the core verb: hammering, throwing, flying, running, sliding, punching, firing
Bright green grass/brick ground under a cyan sky
Power-fantasy body or gear: hyper-muscular mog physique, flaming dual swords, minigun soldier, red-eyed armour

mechanic:plus_one_stat.newcomer_shift: All 4 NEW games keep the +1 popups, so the formula is fixed. They push escalation harder ('+1M/s', '+1T', 'WORLD 2' banner, minigun soldier vs zombie horde) and lean into power fantasy (muscle punching an ice egg, red-eyed armoured FPS figure).
mechanic:plus_one_stat.summary: +1 stat games are a strict formula: a bacon-hair Roblox avatar mid-action on a bright green/cyan baseplate, surrounded by scattered white '+1' popups, with thumbnails that escalate from weak to huge.
mechanic:plus_one_stat.text_usage: The '+1' itself is the text, repeated 4-8 times as decoration. Beyond that: short rarity labels on eggs, stud-height labels, and red bottom banners ('HALLOWEEN', 'WORLD 2'). Game names never appear.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: '+1' popups floating along the action (or '+1T' at the high end)
Escalation split screen with a diagonal or vertical divider: weak→strong (forge → '+1T' sword, sad bust → chiselled jaw, bacon → soldier vs zombie horde)
Bright saturated simulator scene with a cyan sky
Egg reward with a gradient rarity label ('KING EGG MYTHIC', 'DRAGON EGG FROST', 'T.REX EGG MYTHIC')

mechanic:quiz_guess.art_style: Bright, flat cartoon composites: Roblox avatars pasted against 2D IP art or UI mockups (7/8). One is a cropped moody avatar close-up.
avoid: Cropped or ambiguous close-ups that don't say what you're guessing
Thumbnails with no visible question or choices
mechanic:quiz_guess.direction: Icon: a bold 'GUESS THE ___?' headline across the top, a head-scratching bacon-hair with red '?' marks, and the mystery object or answer choices big in the lower half on a bright blue sky. Thumbnail: the full quiz moment, with the question in outlined type, 3-4 options lined up with the last as a '?' box, and a red arrow pointing at the one to guess.
do: Write the question as the headline in chunky two-tone outlined type ('GUESS THE ___?') across the top third
Show a puzzled bacon-hair avatar with a hand on their head and two or three red '?' marks floating above
Lay the answer choices out clearly (3-5 swatches, cards or options), with one shown as a '?' box
Use a bright blue sky with cartoon clouds behind
Show the comparison or mystery object big enough to read at icon size (e.g. Earth vs a tiny avatar with a height ruler)

icon_patterns.pattern: Big question marks (red/white '?' over heads, '?' card, 'WHAT COLOR?!')
Answer choices visible (colour swatches, Guess Who board, song-player UI with play button, two album covers with checkmarks, row of coloured smileys)
The question as a bold outlined headline ('What Color?', 'WHAT COLOR?!', 'PARTY MODE! 4 PLAYERS', Thai title text)
Avatar in a thinking pose: hand on head or chin, puzzled face
Recognisable IP characters (Anya and Gojo, Gumball, real Thai music artists)

mechanic:quiz_guess.summary: Quiz/guess games put the question on the art: a headline like 'What Color?', a puzzled Roblox avatar surrounded by '?' marks, and the answer choices laid out in view, often with recognisable IP characters.
mechanic:quiz_guess.text_usage: Heaviest text of any niche. The question itself is the headline (4/8), in chunky outlined two-tone type, plus UI labels (Easy-Impossible, 0.1s, '1.8m') and question marks used as text.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Headline question text in thick outlined yellow/red/blue type ('GUESS THE SIZE', 'What Color?', 'WHAT COLOR?!', Thai title)
Puzzled or thinking character with '?' marks (headphone bacon, chin-hand cartoon rivals, bacon between album covers, head-scratching bacon)
The answer options laid out for the viewer to guess along (swatches, board, difficulty UI, albums, smiley sequence ending in '?')
Bright blue sky with cartoon clouds as the backdrop
IP characters as the bait

mechanic:rng_roll.art_style: Mixed. Bright simulator renders (about 6/12) sit alongside anime illustration (2-3/12) and dark/horror (2/12). No single style dominates the leaders; the NEW games are uniformly bright simulator.
avoid: Dark, logo-only art unless you can match established-brand polish
Dense lore text in the thumbnail
mechanic:rng_roll.direction: Icon: a bacon-hair avatar wrapped in a crackling coloured aura, holding up a glowing Mythic reward with a rainbow-outlined rarity tag above it. Thumbnail: a two-panel split from a dull first roll labelled '1' to a blazing Mythic reward labelled '999M', joined by a fat red curved arrow on a bright sky.
do: Show the jump in rarity, not just the odds: a split thumbnail with a low roll ('1') on the left, a red arrow, and a glowing Mythic reward with '$967Qa' on the right
Wrap the hero avatar in a coloured aura (lightning or fire glow) to signal a rare roll
If you use odds, run one rainbow-outlined '1 in 800,000,000' line across the top, not a paragraph
Use a bright saturated setting with a bacon-hair avatar; add a red 'YOU' arrow for the player-perspective hook
Keep a single glowing reward object (orb, weapon, creature) as the payoff focal point

icon_patterns.pattern: Bacon-hair or classic noob avatar as the subject
High-energy aura lighting: glowing auras, lightning, speed lines or fire behind the character (anime dice warrior, red Sol's beam, Anime Astral, VS face-off, planet orb)
Bright simulator setting (floating islands, ocean pier, treehouse/pagoda, pink candy path)
Overlay symbols: '+1' popups, 'NOW' + hourglass, or +1 flexing-arm icons

mechanic:rng_roll.newcomer_shift: All 4 NEW games (Aura Dance Battles, Chop Trees, Defend Your Treehouse, Roll Ice Cream) are bright bacon-hair simulator art. 3/4 thumbnails tell a before→after or 'this is you' story with red arrows and split panels. None shows '1 in X' odds: they show the escalating reward instead.
mechanic:rng_roll.summary: RNG roll leaders sell rarity through mood (anime aura art, '1 in X' odds, horror darkness, logos), while all NEW entrants switch to bright bacon-hair progression stories built from split panels and red arrows.
mechanic:rng_roll.text_usage: Leaders use logos and odds lines ('1 in X'). NEW games use progression labels ('Wave 1/15/99', '1' vs '999M', 'Mythic $967Qa'), 'YOU', 'VS' and the '6 7' meme in red outlined type.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Huge value or rarity number as the hook ('1 in 9,342,584', '1 in 800,000,000', 'MASSIVE ORCA $9,732,457,643/s', 'Mythic $967Qa')
Game logo in a corner (EVADE, Sol's RNG, Anime Astral, Threshold)
Dark, desaturated or monochrome drama (Sol's teal void, horror face in a tunnel, black-and-white slap with troll face)
Red arrows telling a progression or pointing at you (1 → 999M split, Wave 1 → 15 → 99 panels, 'YOU' arrow)
